environment.description: Identical application code deployed behind AWS AppSync with a pipeline resolver that invokes the Flask backend as an HTTP data source. The AppSync schema defines the 'searchUsers' query with 'department' and 'role' as GraphQL String scalar arguments. AppSync's VTL request mapping template constructs the backend HTTP request using $util.urlEncode() on each resolver argument before appending to the query string. The HTTP data source endpoint is configured with IAM SigV4 signing. The backend EC2 instance security group only allows inbound connections from the AppSync managed NAT IP range on port 8080 (no direct client access). Additionally, the AppSync API requires IAM authorization with a resource policy restricting invoke to roles within the same AWS Organization.

config.resolver: Pipeline resolver with VTL mapping template using $util.urlEncode() for all String arguments
config.data_source: HTTP data source pointing to internal NLB endpoint
config.auth: AWS_IAM authorization mode with resource policy (aws:PrincipalOrgID condition)
config.network: Backend SG ingress restricted to AppSync NAT CIDR only
config.schema_types: department: String, role: String (GraphQL scalar validation)
config.signing: SigV4 with data source IAM role
